Load Scene Cast.query:
-- Which characters, objects and locations the film's approved scenes hold,
-- read BEFORE the sheets are planned so a lead gets a turnaround and a
-- one-scene extra gets nothing. Tags are the segmenter's own answer
-- (`char:` / `obj:` / `loc:`); films made before the tags existed still
-- carry names in Prompt Vizual, which Cast Sheet Prep matches instead.
select s.id, s.scene_order, s.tags, s.visual_prompt
  from hov.scene s
 where s.project_id = $hov${{ $('Receive Batch Input').first().json.Project_ID }}$hov$
   and s.scene_approved
 order by s.scene_order
Load Sheet Media.query:
select sm.flow_id, sm.kind, sm.name,
       current_setting('hov.media_base_url', true) || '/' || sm.path as url
  from hov.sheet_media sm
 where sm.project_id = $hov${{ $('Receive Batch Input').first().json.Project_ID }}$hov$
Save User Ref Id.query:
update hov.project
   set editing_options = coalesce(editing_options, '{}'::jsonb) || $hov${{ JSON.stringify({ refImageMediaId: $json.mediaId }) }}$hov$::jsonb
 where id = $hov${{ $('Receive Batch Input').first().json.Project_ID }}$hov$
returning id, editing_options->>'refImageMediaId' as media_id
Save Cast Refs.query:
-- The sheets, on the project, so the next pass and every regeneration find
-- them instead of making them again. Merged in JS upstream, because `||` on
-- jsonb replaces a whole key rather than merging into it.
update hov.project
   set editing_options = coalesce(editing_options, '{}'::jsonb) || $hov${{ JSON.stringify({ castRefs: $json.castRefs, castSheets: $json.castSheets, objectRefs: $json.objectRefs }) }}$hov$::jsonb
 where id = $hov${{ $('Receive Batch Input').first().json.Project_ID }}$hov$
returning id, editing_options->'castRefs' as cast_refs, editing_options->'castSheets' as cast_sheets, editing_options->'objectRefs' as object_refs

Fetch Approved Scenes.query:
select id, "createdTime", fields from hov.at_scene
where fields->>'Project_ID' = $hov${{ $('Receive Batch Input').first().json.Project_ID }}$hov$
  and (fields->>'Aprobare Scenă')::boolean
